newsitem.title: USA: Best to sell most assets for $410 mln.
newsitem.headline: Best to sell most assets for $410 mln.

text.p: Best Products Co Inc said on Tuesday it signed an enhanced deal to sell substantially all of its retail-related assets to an investor group for about $410 million.

The deal, still subject to approval by the U.S. Bankruptcy Court, includes proceeds from liquidation sales. The new agreement also calls for the investor group to conduct store-closing or similar sales as Best Products' agent at all other Best locations, the company said.
The company said it had anounced earlier an agreement with the same investor group for about $395 million.
The investor group is comprised of Jubilee Limited Partnership III, Bernstein Financial Group LLC, Alco Capital Group Inc and The Nassi Group LLC.
